As per your request, please find the 6-month rates for Safa Complex

August: AED 5,500
September: AED 6,500
October: AED 7,500
November: AED 9,000
December: AED 12,000
January: AED 12,000

Please note that a security deposit of AED 3,000 is required. The booking will be on a monthly basis only (30 nights each month).

Thank you.
